name: Ricardo Alonso
bio:
Ricardo's motorsport journey began in his youth, fueled by his father's passion for rally racing. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, focusing on aerodynamics and vehicle dynamics. After graduating, he started his career at a smaller racing outfit, quickly proving his worth with innovative solutions that improved vehicle performance. His meticulous approach and ability to translate complex engineering concepts into tangible improvements caught the eye of Red Bull Racing, where he climbed the ranks to become Technical Director.

Ricardo's approach to his role is deeply rooted in data analysis and collaboration. He believes in fostering a culture of open communication and continuous learning within his team, encouraging them to challenge assumptions and explore unconventional solutions. His distinctive ability lies in his capacity to distill vast amounts of information into actionable insights, enabling the team to make informed decisions that consistently push the boundaries of performance. He is known to have excellent spatial reasoning, and can visualize complex assemblies in his head.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a lean build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly aligned desk, even at the track.
